basic_details.short_information: One Consultant post is open at the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, New Delhi, purely on a contractual basis. Applications in the prescribed Annexure format, with the requisite documents, go by email to [email protected] within 30 days of publication, that is up to 22 December 2026.

selection_process: Selection for the NCAHP Consultant post has two stages: screening/shortlisting with marks

Screening: the Commission does initial screening/shortlisting of applications with reference to the qualifications and experience of the applicants. Marking: weightage by way of marks is given on a marking scheme based on qualifications and experience. Interview: a list of "Shortlisted candidates" for interview is prepared on the basis of these marks. Only suitable candidates will be called for interview.
important_instructions: Engagement is initially for one year, extendable subject to performance, funding or need. NCAHP or the Consultant can terminate the contract with 30 days' notice or payment in lieu thereof. The Commission has the authority to increase or decrease the number of Consultants required. Working hours are those of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare; a 15-minute grace time may be given. The Consultant may have to come early, sit late or attend on holidays, Saturdays or Sundays, with no extra remuneration. Attendance is marked in the Aadhar Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS). Leave: 30 days in a calendar year (15 in each half), not carried forward. Leave beyond entitlement means no consultancy fee for those days, and services may be terminated for absence of more than 15 days beyond the entitled leave. The Consultant will not carry out paid work of another organisation without approval of the Competent Authority. Resignation must be submitted in hard copy to the Reporting Authority with a mandatory 30-day notice period; a resignation by email will not be considered. An individual can work in NCAHP till s/he attains 70 years.

content_sections.heading: About NCAHP Consultant
content_sections.text: The National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions works under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, from the NIHFW Campus, Academic Block, 2nd Floor, Munirka, New Delhi – 110 067. The Commission is engaging this Consultant on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. The Consultant's work relates to the recognised categories in the Schedule of the NCAHP Act, 2021.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application in the prescribed format may be forwarded to the email id [email protected] . It must be sent within 30 days from the date of publication, up to 22 December 2026. The notice does not prescribe an email subject line. Use the prescribed application format attached to the notice as the Annexure. Fill the form complete in all respects and paste a recent passport size colour photo in the box provided. Attach the requisite documents, including self-attested copies of certificates supporting educational qualification, experience and date of birth. Sign the form, write your name in capital letters and fill in the date and place. Email the application with the documents to [email protected] by 22 December 2026. An application without the duly filled prescribed proforma will be summarily rejected. The Annexure form asks for: the name of the position applied for, full name, father's name, address for correspondence, mobile phone number, email address, permanent address, date of birth and present age (as on crucial date), educational qualifications (qualification, board/university, year of passing, maximum marks, marks obtained, percentage) and details of employment (post held, department/organisation, from, to, nature of duties performed).

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Post Graduate Degree in the following broad areas, under the category "Medical Technologist and Physician Associate" (Allied & Healthcare Professional): (i) Bio Medical Engineer (ii) Medical Equipment Technologist (iii) Physician Associate (iv) cardiovascular technologist (v) Perfusionist (vi) Respiratory Technologist (vii) Electrocardiogram or Echocardiogram Technologist, Electroencephalogram (EEG) or Electroneurodiagnostic (END) or Electromyography (EMG) Technologist or Neurolab Technologist or Sleep Lab Technologist (viii) Dialysis Therapy Technology or Urology Technologist Minimum experience required for Consultant is 2 years (experience of the domain: greater than or equal to 2 years). Practical experience in any two of these areas: Clinical, Training, Documentation, Data analysis, Research. Demonstrated ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team environment, taking initiative and delivering quality inputs within strict timelines. Preference will be given for experience of working with government officials at central and state level. Excellent analytical skills, oral and written communication and presentation skills in English, and interpersonal abilities. Computer proficiency with a high level of familiarity with commonly used packages like MS Word, Excel, Power Point, as well as web surfing to search relevant data and documents. Willingness to travel to states to provide technical assistance and ability to work on different assignments simultaneously to meet the timelines for assignments. The upper age limit for Consultant is 50 years as on the last date of receiving application. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. The consultancy remuneration is paid within the band of the position, Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 90,000/-. It is decided mainly on educational qualification and experience and is required to be at parity within the division. An annual increase of up to a maximum of 5% is permissible depending on performance appraisal, and an additional 02% may be given with the approval of the Competent Authority if the Commission feels so based on performance. Income Tax or any other tax is deducted at source, and TDS certificates are issued by the Commission. The consultancy fee is normally disbursed on the last working date of every month after deducting TDS, based on timely submission of attendance. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.pay: Lower Limit Rs. 60,000/- ; Higher Limit Rs. 90,000/-

content_sections.heading: NCAHP Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide technical assistance and support to the Council in framing policies and standards for the governance of education and professional services of recognised categories in the Schedule of the NCAHP Act, 2021, including professional conduct, code of ethics and etiquettes. Support creation and maintenance of an up-to-date online and live Central Register for allied and healthcare professionals. Assist in developing the scope of practice of related professions, keeping in view the need for task shifting. Undertake research and assist in formulating basic standards in education: course and curricula, physical and instructional facilities, staff pattern, qualifications, assessment, examination, training, research and continuing professional education, in coordination with the Boards. Support decision-making (with research) on qualifications to be obtained by professionals as specified by regulations. Support creation of a framework for uniform entry examination and counselling for admission into allied and healthcare institutions at undergraduate and post-graduate level. Contribute to minimum standards for machinery, materials and services, and to digitisation of learning, examinations and related processes. Carry out literature review and research on global practices to support guidelines on performance management, task shifting, career pathways, manpower deployment and recognition and reciprocity of qualifications. Conduct periodic monitoring and review visits, collect data, prepare reports, follow up with States and provide technical assistance. Supervise the work of juniors, coordinate interdisciplinary and recognised category matters, and undertake other functions assigned by higher authorities.

Marking: weightage by way of marks is given on a marking scheme based on qualifications and experience. Interview: a list of "Shortlisted candidates" for interview is prepared on the basis of these marks. Only suitable candidates will be called for interview.

Working hours are those of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare; a 15-minute grace time may be given. The Consultant may have to come early, sit late or attend on holidays, Saturdays or Sundays, with no extra remuneration. Attendance is marked in the Aadhar Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS). Leave: 30 days in a calendar year (15 in each half), not carried forward. Leave beyond entitlement means no consultancy fee for those days, and services may be terminated for absence of more than 15 days beyond the entitled leave. The Consultant will not carry out paid work of another organisation without approval of the Competent Authority. Resignation must be submitted in hard copy to the Reporting Authority with a mandatory 30-day notice period; a resignation by email will not be considered.
